'''HNK Branitelj''' ({{langx|hr|Hrvatski nogometni klub Branitelj}}) is a [[association football|football]] club based in [[Rodoč]], [[Mostar]] in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. They played the 2020–21 season at the 4th level of the Bosnia-Herzegovina football pyramid.

Their home ground is Stadion Sportskog Centra in Rodoč which holds about 1,000 people."}}
